To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

RCAS1 and metallothionein expression are associated with immune mediated apoptosis and immune response regulation in neoplasm, decidua and non-neoplasmic lesions originating from the same anatomical region.

the growth of immune mediated apoptosis and ability to regulate cytotoxic immune response in tumor environment and decidua are the main phenomena that are responsible for neoplasm survival or creation of immune tolerance.

the growth of the immune-mediated apoptosis is associated with the growing infiltration of the activated immunological cells in tumor environment and decidua, and the growth of the Metallothionein in response to the increased cytotoxic activity and spread of the tumor.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the evaluation of the ability to compensate cytotoxic immune activity in tumor environment and decidua.
the characterization of the exposure of immune mediated apoptosis in neoplasm environment and decidua.
the characterization of the local immunological response in the neoplasm environment and decidua.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the expression of RCAS1 and MT in tumor environment is a response to the growing immune cytotoxic activity and that the growth of this activity might be associated with tumor growth.
the immune response is a very complex and dynamic process.
the immune response is regulated by the tumor environment and decidua.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
RCAS1 and metallothionein expression is a marker of the immune mediated apoptosis and regulation of cytotoxic immune response in the environment of neoplasm and decidua.
metallothionein expression is a marker of local immunological response to neoplasm, whereas RCAS1 is a marker of immune tolerance in pregnancy.

the growth of cytotoxic immune response and apoptosis in the tumor environment is accompanied by the increase in the Metallothionein and the RCAS1 expression and that these phenomena are physiologically observed during pregnancy and in the environment of endometriosis and nasal polyps.
The main takeaway from our work is that
RCAS1 and metallothionein are useful markers for monitoring of immune response in tumor environment and in decidua and that their expression is associated with local immune tolerance.
the immune mediated apoptosis and regulation of cytotoxic immune response play fundamental roles in neoplasm survival, and in the creation of tolerance during pregnancy.
Metallothionein and the RCAS1 protein are the important markers for the characterization of the immune response in neoplasm, decidua and other non-neoplastic lesions.
